title: Entire Building Above Boot Barn - Sleeps 16
description:
Nestled above Boot Barn on iconic Broadway, our quartet of magnificent lofts awaits the discerning traveler. These architectural gems bathe in natural luminescence through towering nine-foot windows, offering privileged vistas of Nashville's pulsing heart. Sumptuous velvet textures and gilded accents adorn these sanctuaries where soaring ceilings crown hardwood elegance below. The space
Keep your finger on the pulse of Nashville in these beautiful lofts located ON BROADWAY! I own all 4 units in the building, located directly above Boot Barn! Be on the same block with some of the world’s most famous honky tonks such as Tootsie’s, Robert’s Western World, Legend’s Corner and The Stage. Bridgestone Arena and Ryman Auditorium are only one block away! Perfect for big groups who want to experience Nashville like a local!

All 4 kitchens have DRIP coffee makers!

Guest access

Other things to note
** While staying with us, PLEASE make sure ALL doors are shut and locked when not in use! PLEASE do not leave any valuables in your vehicle if parked on the street. Nashville is a BIG city so please make sure to be vigilant with our property and yours!!

This loft is a street view loft, the windows open up to Broadway!!

NO FREE PARKING. The closest parking lot is on 4th and Broadway. Highly recommended that you not rent a car unless you're wanting to venture outside of Nashville. Cabs, Uber, and Lyft are the best way to get around! I have some promo codes at the lofts for free first rides if anyone in your group is a first time Uber or Lyft rider - so make sure to download the apps before you arrive!
